2391def _build_and_render_animation( 

2392 trial_words: pd.DataFrame, 

2393 trial_fixations: pd.DataFrame, 

2394 words_b: Optional[pd.DataFrame], 

2395 fixations_b: Optional[pd.DataFrame], 

2396 selected_participant: str, 

2397 selected_trial: str, 

2398 compare_participant: Optional[str], 

2399 compare_trial: Optional[str], 

2400 *, 

2401 settings: FigureSettings, 

2402 viz_settings: dict, 

2403 playback_speed: float, 

2404 drift_corrected: bool = False, 

2405): 

2406 """Build + render the animation figure (single or dual co-animation) in the 

2407 main column. Returns ``(fig, playback_ms, save_slug, file_stem)``. 

2408 

2409 ``trial_fixations`` / ``fixations_b`` arrive already drift-corrected (PRE-3 is 

2410 applied once by the caller for all three render paths); ``drift_corrected`` 

2411 just says so, so the single replay can force colour-by-line the way the static 

2412 figure does. There is no connector layer here — see the note at the hoist.""" 

2413 dual = fixations_b is not None and not fixations_b.empty 

2414 grid_step_ms = viz_settings.get("anim_grid_step_ms") 

2415 max_frames = viz_settings.get("anim_max_frames") 

2416 _reading_span_ms, playback_ms = animation_playback_ms( 

2417 [trial_fixations] + ([fixations_b] if dual else []), 

2418 playback_speed, 

2419 grid_step_ms=grid_step_ms, 

2420 max_frames=max_frames, 

2421 ) 

2422 # The reading-time / playback info box renders in the side panel under the 

2423 # Animate toggle (see _render_anim_info_box), not here. 

2424 animation_settings = settings.with_overrides( 

2425 playback_speed=playback_speed, 

2426 # Drift correction colours the replay by assigned line, exactly as the 

2427 # static figure does once an algorithm is picked. 

2428 color_by_line=bool(settings.color_by_line or drift_corrected), 

2429 # The replay has no border-overlay layer, so only the text-marking mode 

2430 # carries a highlight column. 

2431 highlight_column=_marked_text_column(viz_settings), 

2432 show_legend=viz_settings.get("show_compare_legend", False), 

2433 label_a=( 

2434 _resolve_compare_label( 

2435 0, selected_participant, selected_trial, trial_words, trial_fixations 

2436 ) 

2437 if dual 

2438 else "Scanpath A" 

2439 ), 

2440 label_b=( 

2441 _resolve_compare_label( 

2442 1, compare_participant, compare_trial, words_b, fixations_b 

2443 ) 

2444 if dual 

2445 else "Scanpath B" 

2446 ), 

2447 autoplay=viz_settings.get("anim_autoplay", True), 

2448 anim_grid_step_ms=grid_step_ms, 

2449 anim_max_frames=max_frames, 

2450 ) 

2451 fig = make_scanpath_animation( 

2452 trial_words, 

2453 trial_fixations, 

2454 settings=animation_settings, 

2455 fixations_b=fixations_b if dual else None, 

2456 words_b=words_b if dual else None, 

2457 ) 

2458 add_illustration_label(fig, viz_settings.get("illustration_reasons")) 

2459 _apply_preprocessing_caption(fig, selected_participant, selected_trial) 

2460 _apply_title_caption( 

2461 fig, 

2462 viz_settings, 

2463 trial_words, 

2464 trial_fixations, 

2465 selected_participant, 

2466 selected_trial, 

2467 ) 

2468 _render_true_scale_chart(fig, key="single_anim") 

2469 if dual: 

2470 save_slug = ( 

2471 f"{selected_participant}__{selected_trial}__vs__" 

2472 f"{compare_participant}__{compare_trial}" 

2473 ) 

2474 file_stem = ( 

2475 f"animation_{_safe_filename(selected_participant)}__" 

2476 f"{_safe_filename(selected_trial)}__vs__" 

2477 f"{_safe_filename(compare_participant)}__" 

2478 f"{_safe_filename(compare_trial)}" 

2479 ) 

2480 else: 

2481 save_slug = f"{selected_participant}__{selected_trial}" 

2482 file_stem = ( 

2483 f"animation_{_safe_filename(selected_participant)}__" 

2484 f"{_safe_filename(selected_trial)}" 

2485 ) 

2486 return fig, playback_ms, save_slug, file_stem

2489def _render_export_panel( 

2490 displayed_fig, 

2491 *, 

2492 animate: bool, 

2493 save_slug: str, 

2494 playback_ms: Optional[float], 

2495 file_stem: Optional[str], 

2496 combos: pd.DataFrame, 

2497 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

2498 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

2499 combos_all: pd.DataFrame, 

2500 words_all: pd.DataFrame, 

2501 fixations_all: pd.DataFrame, 

2502 raw_gaze: pd.DataFrame, 

2503 canvas_width: int, 

2504 canvas_height: int, 

2505 base_font_size: int, 

2506 font_family: str, 

2507 viz_settings: dict, 

2508 line_spacing: float, 

2509 scale_text_to_boxes: bool, 

2510) -> None: 

2511 """Consolidated Export subtab: the currently-viewed figure on top, then a 

2512 bulk multi-trial export below. 

2513 

2514 Replaces both the old single-trial Export toggle and the standalone Bulk 

2515 Export tab. "This trial" exports the live figure (static PNG/SVG/PDF/HTML, or 

2516 the HTML/GIF/MP4 animation when animating) so the on-screen view — including 

2517 a comparison or animation — round-trips exactly; the bulk section rebuilds 

2518 static figures across many trials.""" 

2519 st.markdown("## This trial") 

2520 if displayed_fig is None: 

2521 st.caption("Select a trial to export its figure.") 

2522 elif animate: 

2523 _render_animation_export( 

2524 displayed_fig, 

2525 file_stem=file_stem or "animation", 

2526 playback_ms=playback_ms or 0.0, 

2527 ) 

2528 else: 

2529 _render_save_plot_button( 

2530 displayed_fig, 

2531 canvas_width=int(canvas_width), 

2532 canvas_height=int(canvas_height), 

2533 slug=save_slug, 

2534 key_prefix="single", 

2535 ) 

2536 

2537 st.divider() 

2538 st.markdown("## Multiple trials") 

2539 bulk_settings = _build_figure_settings(viz_settings, False) 

2540 bulk_settings["line_spacing"] = line_spacing 

2541 bulk_settings["scale_text_to_boxes"] = scale_text_to_boxes 

2542 # EXP-4 / VIZ-24: the bulk export rebuilds every figure from scratch, so the 

2543 # PRE-3 drift correction must ride along or the batch silently differs from 

2544 # the corrected figure on screen. Applied per trial inside `bulk_export` 

2545 # (figures only — the exported tables stay uncorrected by design). 

2546 bulk_settings["align_algorithm"] = viz_settings.get("align_algorithm", "Off") 

2547 bulk_settings["align_connectors"] = bool(viz_settings.get("align_connectors")) 

2548 # EXP-5: the rail's title/caption pattern is the single source of truth — 

2549 # bulk export reads it back rather than keeping its own copy. 

2550 bulk_settings["title_pattern"] = viz_settings.get("title_pattern", "") 

2551 bulk_settings["caption_pattern"] = viz_settings.get("caption_pattern", "") 

2552 bulk_settings["preprocessing"] = dict( 

2553 st.session_state.get("_preprocessing_settings") or {} 

2554 ) 

2555 report = st.session_state.get("_preprocessing_report") 

2556 bulk_settings["preprocessing_report"] = ( 

2557 report.to_dict("records") if isinstance(report, pd.DataFrame) else [] 

2558 ) 

2559 from scanpath_studio.experimental_setup import pixels_per_degree 

2560 

2561 try: 

2562 bulk_settings["pixels_per_degree"] = pixels_per_degree( 

2563 float(st.session_state.get("global_viewing_distance_mm", 800.0)), 

2564 float(canvas_width), 

2565 float(st.session_state.get("global_monitor_width_mm", 597.0)), 

2566 ) 

2567 except (TypeError, ValueError): 

2568 pass 

2569 _render_bulk_export( 

2570 combos, 

2571 words_filtered, 

2572 fixations_filtered, 

2573 combos_all, 

2574 words_all, 

2575 fixations_all, 

2576 raw_gaze, 

2577 canvas_width=int(canvas_width), 

2578 canvas_height=int(canvas_height), 

2579 base_font_size=int(base_font_size), 

2580 font_family=font_family, 

2581 x_field=viz_settings["x_field"], 

2582 y_field=viz_settings["y_field"], 

2583 figure_settings=bulk_settings, 

2584 ) 

2585 

2586 

2587_CHIP_NEUTRAL_BG = "#EEF2F7" 

2588# Friendly labels for the identity fields; everything else is humanized. 

2589_CHIP_FIELD_LABELS = { 

2590 "participant_id": "Participant", 

2591 "unique_text_id": "Text", 

2592 "text_id": "Text", 

2593 "unique_paragraph_id": "Text", 

2594 "paragraph_id": "Text", 

2595 # MultiplEYE facets + reader metadata. 

2596 "genre": "Genre", 

2597 "session": "Session", 

2598 "is_practice": "Practice", 

2599 "trial_num": "Trial #", 

2600 "pp_age": "Age", 

2601 "pp_gender": "Gender", 

2602 "pp_native_language": "Native language", 

2603 "pp_years_education": "Years of education", 

2604 "pp_education_level": "Education", 

2605} 

2606 

2607 

2608def _chip_field_label(col: str) -> str: 

2609 """Friendly label for a chip field (summary / identity, else humanized).""" 

2610 if col in SUMMARY_CHIP_FIELDS: 

2611 return SUMMARY_CHIP_FIELDS[col] 

2612 return _CHIP_FIELD_LABELS.get(col, _humanize_field(col)) 

2613 

2614 

2615def _chip_value_and_uniqueness(col, trial_words, trial_fixations, participant): 

2616 """``(value, is_trial_level)`` for ``col`` in the trial. 

2617 

2618 ``value`` is the first non-null (words first, then fixations); 

2619 ``participant_id`` resolves to the selected participant. ``is_trial_level`` is 

2620 False when the column varies *within* this trial (so the single chip value is 

2621 misleading) — a cheap ``nunique`` on the trial's own (small) rows, used only to 

2622 warn. ``participant_id`` is trivially trial-level. Returns ``(None, True)`` 

2623 when nothing resolves.""" 

2624 if col == "participant_id": 

2625 return (participant or None, True) 

2626 for src in (trial_words, trial_fixations): 

2627 if src is not None and not src.empty and col in src.columns: 

2628 series = src[col] 

2629 non_null = series.dropna() 

2630 if non_null.empty: 

2631 return (None, True) 

2632 return (non_null.iloc[0], int(series.nunique(dropna=True)) <= 1) 

2633 return (None, True) 

2634 

2635 

2636def _chip_color(col: str, value_str: str) -> str: 

2637 """Background for a chip. 

2638 

2639 UX-28: a user-picked colour (any field, any dataset — set via the ✏️ Edit 

2640 chips popover's **Chip colours** section, `trial_chip_colors`) wins over 

2641 everything below. Absent that, known OneStop conditions keep their 

2642 metadata-table colour so the demo reads the same as before this was 

2643 generalized; everything else is neutral. 

2644 """ 

2645 override = (st.session_state.get("trial_chip_colors") or {}).get(col) 

2646 if override: 

2647 return override 

2648 v = value_str.lower() 

2649 if col == "difficulty_level": 

2650 for prefix, color in _DIFFICULTY_COLORS.items(): 

2651 if v.startswith(prefix): 

2652 return color 

2653 elif col == "question_preview" and v in ("true", "1"): 

2654 return _PREVIEW_COLOR 

2655 elif col == "repeated_reading_trial" and v in ("true", "1"): 

2656 return _REPEAT_COLOR 

2657 elif col == "is_correct": 

2658 if v in ("true", "1"): 

2659 return "#d4edda" 

2660 if v in ("false", "0"): 

2661 return "#f8d7da" 

2662 return _CHIP_NEUTRAL_BG 

2663 

2664 

2665def _render_trial_condition_chips( 

2666 trial_words: pd.DataFrame, 

2667 trial_fixations: pd.DataFrame, 

2668 participant: Optional[str], 

2669 fields, 

2670) -> list[tuple[str, str]]: 

2671 """Render the ``Field = Value`` chip strip above the plot — the trial's 

2672 identity and experiment conditions, so "what am I looking at" is answered at 

2673 a glance (these chips replaced the Trial Info subtab). 

2674 

2675 **UX-11.** The strip used to be pinned to one line, clipping whatever didn't 

2676 fit, with a **More** disclosure that re-listed *every* chip so the clipped 

2677 ones stayed reachable — the same facts shown twice, because which chips fit 

2678 is a live-width question Python can't answer. The fix is to stop asking: the 

2679 strip is a wrapping flex row, so nothing is ever cut at any width or sidebar 

2680 state, and the duplicate list has no reason to exist. What's left is split by 

2681 *kind* rather than by what happened to fit — conditions inline here, the 

2682 computed summary stats in the **Details** popover the caller renders from the 

2683 returned list. 

2684 

2685 ``fields`` is the configurable list of fields to surface (the ✏️ Edit chips 

2686 popover). A data column that varies within the trial is shown (first value) 

2687 but flagged with ⚠️. 

2688 

2689 Returns the ``(label, value)`` summary stats for the Details popover; empty 

2690 when the user has no summary chips selected.""" 

2691 primary: list[tuple[str, str]] = [] # identity + conditions (inline) 

2692 summary: list[tuple[str, str]] = [] # computed stats (inside "More") 

2693 summary_lookup: Optional[dict] = None # computed once, only if a summary chip 

2694 for col in fields or []: 

2695 # Virtual summary fields (reading time / counts) — always trial-level, 

2696 # computed once from `_summary_rows`; routed to the "More" disclosure. 

2697 if col in SUMMARY_CHIP_FIELDS: 

2698 if summary_lookup is None: 

2699 summary_lookup = { 

2700 r["Field"]: r["Value"] 

2701 for r in _summary_rows(trial_words, trial_fixations) 

2702 } 

2703 label = SUMMARY_CHIP_FIELDS[col] 

2704 value = summary_lookup.get(label) 

2705 if value in (None, ""): 

2706 continue # e.g. "Fixations in word boxes" unavailable for this trial 

2707 summary.append((label, str(value))) 

2708 continue 

2709 value, trial_level = _chip_value_and_uniqueness( 

2710 col, trial_words, trial_fixations, participant 

2711 ) 

2712 if value is None: 

2713 continue 

2714 value_str = str(value) 

2715 # Skip empty / missing values (a "string" optional field coerces NaN to 

2716 # the literal "nan", e.g. ET2 readers with no recorded gender). 

2717 if value_str.strip().lower() in ("", "nan", "none", "<na>"): 

2718 continue 

2719 label = _chip_field_label(col) 

2720 prefix = "" if trial_level else "⚠️ " 

2721 primary.append((f"{prefix}{label} = {value_str}", _chip_color(col, value_str))) 

2722 if primary: 

2723 st.markdown( 

2724 '<div class="sps-trial-chips">' 

2725 + "".join( 

2726 f'<span class="sps-chip" style="background:{bg};">' 

2727 f"{html.escape(lbl)}</span>" 

2728 for lbl, bg in primary 

2729 ) 

2730 + "</div>", 

2731 unsafe_allow_html=True, 

2732 ) 

2733 return summary 

2734 

2735 

2736def _render_trial_details_popover(summary: list[tuple[str, str]], host) -> None: 

2737 """The **Details** popover beside the chip strip: the computed summary stats. 

2738 

2739 UX-11 split the strip by *kind*: conditions are chips (short, colour-coded, 

2740 scannable), while reading time / word count / fixation counts are derived 

2741 numbers that read far better as a key→value list — and are the "on demand" 

2742 half of the strip's job. Renders nothing when the user has no summary chips 

2743 selected, so the control never appears empty. 

2744 """ 

2745 if not summary: 

2746 return 

2747 with host.popover("Details", width="content", help="Summary stats for this trial."): 

2748 st.markdown( 

2749 "".join( 

2750 '<div class="sps-stat">' 

2751 f'<span class="sps-stat-name">{html.escape(name)}</span>' 

2752 f'<span class="sps-stat-val">{html.escape(value)}</span>' 

2753 "</div>" 

2754 for name, value in summary 

2755 ), 

2756 unsafe_allow_html=True, 

2757 ) 

2758 

2759 

2760def render_single_trial_tab( 

2761 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

2762 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

2763 combos: pd.DataFrame, 

2764 *, 

2765 canvas_width: int, 

2766 canvas_height: int, 

2767 base_font_size: int, 

2768 font_family: str, 

2769 raw_gaze: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, 

2770 line_spacing: float = DEFAULT_LINE_SPACING, 

2771 scale_text_to_boxes: bool = True, 

2772 combos_all: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, 

2773 words_all: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, 

2774 fixations_all: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, 

2775 share_renderer: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None, 

2776 # UX-25: renders the data-source picker into the "Filter by" row's first 

2777 # column. Passed by ``app.main`` (which owns the source list + wizard hooks). 

2778 data_source_renderer: Optional[Callable[[object], None]] = None, 

2779 canvas_renderer: Optional[Callable[[Any], None]] = None, 

2780) -> None: 

2781 """Render the main Scanpath Visualization screen (static + animated). 

2782 

2783 Layout, designed for use with the sidebar closed (everything needed is beside 

2784 the plot, no scrolling): 

2785 

2786 1. A compact **selection bar** above the plot — the trial picker + a 🔍 Filter 

2787 expander, with a strip of experiment-condition chips below it (the trial's 

2788 "what am I looking at" at a glance). 

2789 2. A **plot + right rail** split: the scanpath plot on the left, and a control 

2790 rail on the right carrying the **view modes** (Animate / Compare) and the 

2791 **visualization controls** (formerly in the sidebar — see 

2792 ``controls.sidebar_controls``, rendered here with ``host=``). 

2793 3. A plot-width **subtab bar** directly below it: 📝 Annotations · Stimulus & questions · 

2794 Export · 🔎 Data Inspection · 🔗 Share. Export folds in the former Bulk 

2795 Export tab (``_render_export_panel``); Data Inspection (the former 

2796 standalone view) renders inline here; Share (the former header popover) 

2797 builds the deep link via ``share_renderer`` (passed by ``app.main``). The 

2798 former Trial Info subtab was folded into the chips above the plot. Save & 

2799 restore lives in the sidebar. 

2800 

2801 ``combos_all`` / ``words_all`` / ``fixations_all`` are the unfiltered frames 

2802 the Export subtab's bulk section uses for its "whole dataset" scope; they 

2803 fall back to the filtered frames when not supplied. 

2804 """ 

2805 if combos_all is None: 

2806 combos_all = combos 

2807 if words_all is None: 

2808 words_all = words_filtered 

2809 if fixations_all is None: 

2810 fixations_all = fixations_filtered 

2811 

2812 # --- Plot (left) + control rail (right) ----------------------------------- 

2813 # Columns FIRST so the rail starts at the very top, beside the selection — 

2814 # built for the sidebar-closed workflow. The selection menus + chips + plot all 

2815 # live in the left column, including the per-trial subtabs directly below the 

2816 # plot. The rail is kept narrow (the plot is the hero) and scrolls separately. 

2817 plot_col, rail_col = st.columns([4, 1], gap="large") 

2818 with rail_col: 

2819 rail = st.container(key="scanpath_rail") 

2820 

2821 with plot_col: 

2822 # Narrow-by row: [Data source] [Filter by] [Text multiselect] 

2823 # [Participant multiselect] [More popover]. UX-25 put the data source 

2824 # first, so the row reads left-to-right as *which dataset → how to narrow 

2825 # it → which trial*. The Text/Participant multiselects narrow the pool; 

2826 # "More" holds the condition + annotation filters. The specific trial is 

2827 # picked on the row below (select_trial → selectbox + slider + ◀ ▶). 

2828 # UX-42: Data source and Filter by have separate tour steps, so they need 

2829 # sibling spotlight targets even though they share one visual row. The 

2830 # nested columns preserve the existing proportions: 2.2 for the source, 

2831 # then 0.9 + 2.2 + 2.2 + 1.1 for the narrowing controls. 

2832 nb_source, nb_filters = st.columns([2.2, 6.4], vertical_alignment="center") 

2833 # Rendered by app (it owns the entry list + the wizard hooks) — see 

2834 # app.render_data_source_picker; its own `tour_grp_data_source` wrapper 

2835 # now sits beside, rather than inside, the Filter-by spotlight. 

2836 if data_source_renderer is not None: 

2837 data_source_renderer(nb_source) 

2838 

2839 filter_box = nb_filters.container(key="tour_grp_narrow_by") 

2840 nb_label, nb_text, nb_part, more_col = filter_box.columns( 

2841 [0.9, 2.2, 2.2, 1.1], vertical_alignment="center" 

2842 ) 

2843 nb_label.markdown("**Filter by**") 

2844 render_narrow_by(words_all, fixations_all, text_host=nb_text, part_host=nb_part) 

2845 with more_col: 

2846 # UX-27: keyed so styles.py can give it the shared rail-button 

2847 # shape, matching the picker's ◀ ▶ ⇅ and the chip row below. 

2848 more_pop = st.container(key="railbtn_more").popover("More", width="content") 

2849 more_pop.caption("More ways to narrow — conditions & annotations.") 

2850 render_trial_filters(words_all, fixations_all, host=more_pop) 

2851 # Trial picker (its own row of columns): selectbox + slider + ◀ ▶. 

2852 # Pass the More-popover filter columns so composite components that are 

2853 # also conditions (e.g. repeated_reading_trial) narrow there, not as a 

2854 # dedicated trial selector — keeping the picker stable across datasets. 

2855 with st.container(key="tour_grp_trial_picker"): 

2856 selected_participant, selected_trial, selection_mode, selected_text = ( 

2857 select_trial( 

2858 combos, 

2859 key_prefix="single", 

2860 filter_cols=_filter_fields_for(words_all, fixations_all), 

2861 # UX-10: the frames `combos` was built from, so the ⇅ sort 

2862 # popover can offer computed keys (fixation count, reading 

2863 # time) alongside the reader / text / condition columns. 

2864 words=words_filtered, 

2865 fixations=fixations_filtered, 

2866 ) 

2867 ) 

2868 screen_slot = st.container(key="tour_grp_screen_picker") 

2869 # Slots filled once the selection is resolved (chips need the trial). The 

2870 # compare-trial selector (CMP-1) sits above the chips, below the picker. 

2871 # Keyed containers double as welcome-tour spotlight targets. 

2872 compare_slot = st.container() 

2873 chips_slot = st.container(key="tour_grp_chips") 

2874 plot_slot = st.container(key="tour_grp_plot") 

2875 

2876 # UX-43: a second row repeats the 4:1 split and reserves only its left side 

2877 # for the per-trial panels. Keeping the slot OUT of the plot/rail row means 

2878 # an open Annotations (or any other) panel cannot make the rail taller than 

2879 # the plot above it; the blank right cell preserves exact plot-column width. 

2880 subtabs_col, _ = st.columns([4, 1], gap="large") 

2881 subtabs_slot = subtabs_col.container(key="tour_grp_subtabs") 

2882 

2883 if not (selected_participant and selected_trial): 

2884 return 

2885 

2886 # Remember the resolved selection so the header Share button can build a deep 

2887 # link back to exactly this trial (app._build_share_query reads it). 

2888 st.session_state["_share_selection"] = { 

2889 "participant_id": selected_participant, 

2890 "trial_id": selected_trial, 

2891 } 

2892 

2893 parent_words = extract_trial(words_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial) 

2894 parent_fixations = extract_trial( 

2895 fixations_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial 

2896 ) 

2897 parent_raw_gaze = pd.DataFrame() 

2898 if raw_gaze is not None and not raw_gaze.empty: 

2899 parent_raw_gaze = extract_trial(raw_gaze, selected_participant, selected_trial) 

2900 screens = part_catalog(parent_words, parent_fixations) 

2901 with screen_slot: 

2902 selected_screen = _render_screen_navigator(screens) 

2903 if selected_screen is not None: 

2904 trial_words = extract_part( 

2905 parent_words, selected_participant, selected_trial, selected_screen 

2906 ) 

2907 trial_fixations = extract_part( 

2908 parent_fixations, selected_participant, selected_trial, selected_screen 

2909 ) 

2910 if not parent_raw_gaze.empty and SCREEN_ID in parent_raw_gaze.columns: 

2911 trial_raw_gaze = extract_part( 

2912 parent_raw_gaze, 

2913 selected_participant, 

2914 selected_trial, 

2915 selected_screen, 

2916 ) 

2917 else: 

2918 trial_raw_gaze = pd.DataFrame() 

2919 if not parent_raw_gaze.empty: 

2920 screen_slot.warning( 

2921 "Raw gaze has no screen identity, so it is hidden for this " 

2922 "multipart trial rather than concatenated across screens." 

2923 ) 

2924 st.session_state["_share_selection"]["screen_id"] = selected_screen 

2925 per_screen_canvas = screen_canvas_size(trial_words) or screen_canvas_size( 

2926 trial_fixations 

2927 ) 

2928 if per_screen_canvas is not None: 

2929 canvas_width, canvas_height = per_screen_canvas 

2930 else: 

2931 trial_words = parent_words 

2932 trial_fixations = parent_fixations 

2933 trial_raw_gaze = parent_raw_gaze 

2934 trial_has_raw_gaze = not trial_raw_gaze.empty 

2935 has_raw_gaze = raw_gaze is not None and not raw_gaze.empty 

2936 

2937 # Stimulus-page background image (MultiplEYE): the per-trial image path lives 

2938 # on the trial's rows (directory load only — uploads carry no path). The image 

2939 # is offered only when it exists and its pixel size is readable. Its origin 

2940 # (image_x/image_y, where the centered stimulus sits on the monitor) places it 

2941 # to align with the fixations, which carry the same offset. 

2942 trial_image_path = _first_str(trial_words, "image_path") or _first_str( 

2943 trial_fixations, "image_path" 

2944 ) 

2945 trial_image_size = ( 

2946 _png_pixel_size(trial_image_path) 

2947 if trial_image_path and os.path.exists(trial_image_path) 

2948 else None 

2949 ) 

2950 has_stimulus_image = trial_image_size is not None 

2951 trial_image_origin = ( 

2952 _first_num(trial_words, "image_x") 

2953 or _first_num(trial_fixations, "image_x") 

2954 or 0.0, 

2955 _first_num(trial_words, "image_y") 

2956 or _first_num(trial_fixations, "image_y") 

2957 or 0.0, 

2958 ) 

2959 

2960 # Condition chips above the plot are filled later (into chips_slot), once the 

2961 # comparison selection is known — so a second chip strip can show the compared 

2962 # trial too. 

2963 

2964 # Render the rail (plot controls) before the figure so it sees the 

2965 # resolved Animate / Compare / viz settings; its right-side position is fixed 

2966 # by the column split regardless of render order. 

2967 with rail: 

2968 # UX-44: modes, presets, palette and layers are one control system. Keep 

2969 # one heading for the rail and put the scoped reset beside it instead of 

2970 # spending a full-width row at the foot of the scroll area. 

2971 with st.container(key="plot_controls_header"): 

2972 rail_heading, rail_reset = st.columns( 

2973 [1.6, 1], gap="small", vertical_alignment="center" 

2974 ) 

2975 rail_heading.markdown("## 🎛️ Plot controls") 

2976 with rail_reset.container(key="railbtn_plot_reset"): 

2977 render_viz_reset(st, compact=True) 

2978 with rail.container(key="tour_grp_view_modes"): 

2979 # Animate styled like a layer: a toggle + a ⚙ popover for its config 

2980 # (playback speed) — matching Compare and the visualization layers below. 

2981 # Seeded, not `value=`-defaulted: `single_animate` is restored pre-widget 

2982 # by a deep link / saved config (see session_keys), and passing both makes 

2983 # Streamlit warn (BUG-17). `setdefault` suffices — this toggle renders on 

2984 # every run, so it never first mounts late the way a popover-bound widget 

2985 # can (that case needs `persist_state="session"`; see BUG-15/ENG-36). 

2986 st.session_state.setdefault("single_animate", False) 

2987 animate = st.toggle( 

2988 "🎬 **Animate**", 

2989 key="single_animate", 

2990 persist_state="session", 

2991 help="Replay the trial fixation by fixation; the play / pause / " 

2992 "restart controls sit below the plot.", 

2993 ) 

2994 # Reading-time / playback info box, filled below once playback speed + any 

2995 # compare trial are known (lives inside the Playback popover). 

2996 anim_info_slot = None 

2997 # Playback speed shows only when animating a trial that has fixations. 

2998 # Default ×4 — a brisk review pace (real-time ÷ 4). 

2999 playback_speed = _ANIM_DEFAULT_SPEED 

3000 if animate and not trial_fixations.empty: 

3001 with st.popover("⚙️ Playback", width="stretch"): 

3002 st.session_state.setdefault( 

3003 "single_playback_speed", _ANIM_DEFAULT_SPEED 

3004 ) 

3005 playback_speed = st.select_slider( 

3006 "Playback speed", 

3007 options=_ANIM_SPEED_OPTIONS, 

3008 format_func=lambda x: _ANIM_SPEED_LABELS[ 

3009 _ANIM_SPEED_OPTIONS.index(x) 

3010 ], 

3011 help="Playback speed relative to the recorded fixation timings.", 

3012 key="single_playback_speed", 

3013 persist_state="session", 

3014 ) 

3015 # UX-30: the reading-time / playback-duration box reads as a 

3016 # consequence of the speed picked above, so it sits right below it 

3017 # instead of at the foot of the popover. `anim_info_slot` is only a 

3018 # placeholder here — Streamlit lays containers out in creation 

3019 # order, so the actual fill (below, once fixations/compare are 

3020 # known) still lands in this spot. 

3021 # VIZ-10: start the replay automatically on load (at the speed 

3022 # above). Off → the figure waits on the ▶ Play button. UX-30 

3023 # moved it up here: Autoplay and speed are both "how does it 

3024 # play", where the frame grid below is "how is it sampled". 

3025 st.checkbox( 

3026 "Autoplay on load", 

3027 key="global_anim_autoplay", 

3028 persist_state="session", 

3029 help="Start the replay automatically when the plot loads, at " 

3030 "the playback speed set above. Turn off to start paused (press " 

3031 "▶ Play to run it).", 

3032 ) 

3033 anim_info_slot = st.container() 

3034 st.divider() 

3035 # VIZ-11 follow-up: the frame grid is a real tradeoff — smoothness 

3036 # against frame count, which is what export size and render time 

3037 # are made of. It used to be decided for the user in two module 

3038 # constants, and the cap coarsened the grid silently. 

3039 st.caption("**Frame grid**") 

3040 

3041 def _apply_anim_quality() -> None: 

3042 preset = _ANIM_QUALITY_PRESETS.get( 

3043 st.session_state.get("global_anim_quality") 

3044 ) 

3045 if preset is not None: 

3046 ( 

3047 st.session_state["global_anim_grid_step_ms"], 

3048 st.session_state["global_anim_max_frames"], 

3049 ) = preset 

3050 

3051 current_grid = ( 

3052 int(st.session_state.get("global_anim_grid_step_ms", 100)), 

3053 int(st.session_state.get("global_anim_max_frames", 360)), 

3054 ) 

3055 matched_quality = next( 

3056 ( 

3057 name 

3058 for name, values in _ANIM_QUALITY_PRESETS.items() 

3059 if values == current_grid 

3060 ), 

3061 None, 

3062 ) 

3063 # UX-30: gating the sliders behind Custom means picking Custom on 

3064 # the segmented control has to be "sticky" even while the grid 

3065 # still equals a Coarse/Fine preset exactly (the state right after 

3066 # switching, before either slider is touched) — otherwise this 

3067 # same re-inference would immediately snap it back to that preset's 

3068 # name and hide the sliders that were just revealed. Only fall back 

3069 # to inferring Coarse/Fine here when the mode isn't already Custom; 

3070 # a grid matching no preset at all is unambiguous either way. 

3071 previous_quality = st.session_state.get("global_anim_quality") 

3072 if matched_quality is None: 

3073 st.session_state["global_anim_quality"] = "Custom" 

3074 elif previous_quality != "Custom": 

3075 st.session_state["global_anim_quality"] = matched_quality 

3076 st.segmented_control( 

3077 "Animation quality", 

3078 options=["Coarse", "Fine", "Custom"], 

3079 key="global_anim_quality", 

3080 persist_state="session", 

3081 on_change=_apply_anim_quality, 

3082 help="**Coarse** — 300 ms / 120 frames for fast drafts. " 

3083 "**Fine** — 40 ms / 900 frames for high-fidelity review. " 

3084 "**Custom** reveals the sliders below, pre-seeded with " 

3085 "whichever preset was active last.", 

3086 ) 

3087 

3088 def _mark_anim_quality_custom() -> None: 

3089 st.session_state["global_anim_quality"] = "Custom" 

3090 

3091 if st.session_state["global_anim_quality"] == "Custom": 

3092 # UX-30: two short numeric pickers, side by side rather 

3093 # than stacked — the popover is narrow and they are read 

3094 # together (step against cap). 

3095 grid_left, grid_right = st.columns(2) 

3096 _numeric_slider( 

3097 grid_left, 

3098 "Frame every (ms)", 

3099 key="global_anim_grid_step_ms", 

3100 persist_state="session", 

3101 min_value=20, 

3102 max_value=500, 

3103 step=10, 

3104 on_change=_mark_anim_quality_custom, 

3105 help="How often a frame is emitted along the reading " 

3106 "clock. Smaller is smoother and larger to export; the " 

3107 "slider scrubs linearly through seconds either way.", 

3108 ) 

3109 _numeric_slider( 

3110 grid_right, 

3111 "Max frames", 

3112 key="global_anim_max_frames", 

3113 persist_state="session", 

3114 min_value=30, 

3115 max_value=2000, 

3116 step=10, 

3117 on_change=_mark_anim_quality_custom, 

3118 help="Hard ceiling on the frame count. A long reading " 

3119 "coarsens the grid to stay under it rather than " 

3120 "emitting thousands of frames (which balloons the " 

3121 "GIF/MP4 export).", 

3122 ) 

3123 # Compare is a view mode (toggle here); the second-trial selector renders 

3124 # above the chips in the plot column (compare_slot below), mirroring the 

3125 # main trial picker (CMP-1). 

3126 compare_enabled = st.toggle( 

3127 "⚖️ **Compare**", 

3128 value=False, 

3129 key="single_compare_toggle", 

3130 persist_state="session", 

3131 help=( 

3132 "Co-animate a second reading on one clock." 

3133 if animate 

3134 else "Overlay another trial's scanpath or view them side by side." 

3135 ), 

3136 ) 

3137 # ENG-24: controls must gate against the mode the renderer can actually 

3138 # enter, not merely the raw toggle. Compare needs at least one candidate; 

3139 # Animate is resolved independently because it remains a distinct empty- 

3140 # state when the selected trial has no fixations. 

3141 st.session_state["_resolved_comparing"] = bool( 

3142 compare_enabled 

3143 and build_comparison_options( 

3144 combos, 

3145 selection_mode, 

3146 selected_participant, 

3147 selected_trial, 

3148 selected_text, 

3149 ) 

3150 ) 

3151 st.session_state["_resolved_animating"] = bool(animate) 

3152 # Compare config in the rail (moved out of the inline selector): the 

3153 # overlay/side-by-side/stacked layout + the show-A/B-legend toggle. The 

3154 # layout reaches the figure via session_state (`single_compare_layout`), 

3155 # read into `compare_layout` below. 

3156 if compare_enabled: 

3157 with st.popover("⚙️ Compare options", width="stretch"): 

3158 if not animate: 

3159 # Seed so the control shows "Overlay" selected by default 

3160 # (the body reads this key to resolve compare_layout). 

3161 st.session_state.setdefault("single_compare_layout", "Overlay") 

3162 st.segmented_control( 

3163 "View", 

3164 options=["Overlay", "Side by side", "Stacked"], 

3165 key="single_compare_layout", 

3166 persist_state="session", 

3167 help="Stacked = trials shown one above the other.", 

3168 ) 

3169 show_legend_now = st.checkbox( 

3170 "Show A/B legend", 

3171 key="global_show_compare_legend", 

3172 persist_state="session", 

3173 help="Show a legend naming the two scanpaths on the overlay " 

3174 "(off by default — the colours already tell A and B apart).", 

3175 ) 

3176 if show_legend_now: 

3177 # UX-31: override the auto "participant · trial" label, 

3178 # EXP-2-style (same pattern language + live preview as 

3179 # the rail's title/caption). Empty = the auto label. 

3180 # The field vocabulary is spelled out here rather than 

3181 # pointed at: "same fields as the title/caption pattern" 

3182 # only helps a user who has already found that control. 

3183 label_fields = pattern_fields( 

3184 "p01", "t01", pd.DataFrame(), pd.DataFrame(), {} 

3185 ) 

3186 box = st.container() 

3187 for idx, side in ((0, "A"), (1, "B")): 

3188 render_pattern_input( 

3189 box, 

3190 f"Label {side}", 

3191 f"cmp{idx}_label_pattern", 

3192 label_fields, 

3193 # The auto label shows *in* the box, greyed, so 

3194 # what an empty box gives you is readable without 

3195 # hovering the tooltip (UX-31). 

3196 placeholder=DEFAULT_COMPARE_LABEL_PATTERN, 

3197 help="Leave empty for the auto label.", 

3198 ) 

3199 render_pattern_help(box, label_fields) 

3200 # The visualization controls moved out of the sidebar into this rail 

3201 # (host=rail) so they sit beside the plot with the sidebar closed. 

3202 viz_settings = sidebar_controls( 

3203 fixations_filtered, 

3204 base_font_size, 

3205 host=rail, 

3206 has_raw_gaze=has_raw_gaze, 

3207 has_stimulus_image=has_stimulus_image, 

3208 words=words_filtered, 

3209 # The selected trial's fixations size the VIZ-7 fixation-index window 

3210 # slider (its max is this trial's fixation count). 

3211 fix_range_fixations=trial_fixations, 

3212 # VIZ-31: the canvas / text panel (monitor geometry, fonts, text 

3213 # colour, background) renders inside the rail's group order rather 

3214 # than in the sidebar. `app.main` passes it in already bound to the 

3215 # frames + data source, since those are app-side concerns. 

3216 canvas_renderer=canvas_renderer, 

3217 ) 

3218 

3219 # Second-trial selector + layout/legend options, rendered above the chips in 

3220 # the plot column (CMP-1). Filled after the rail so the per-scanpath compare 

3221 # styles (cmp*_ keys) are already seeded — the A/B swatches then match the 

3222 # figure exactly (CMP-3). Only shown when Compare is on. 

3223 compare_participant, compare_trial = None, None 

3224 # Layout comes from the rail's Compare-config popover via session_state; an 

3225 # animated comparison always co-animates on one clock, so force overlay then. 

3226 if animate: 

3227 compare_layout = "overlay" 

3228 else: 

3229 compare_layout = { 

3230 "Overlay": "overlay", 

3231 "Side by side": "side_by_side", 

3232 "Stacked": "stacked", 

3233 }.get(st.session_state.get("single_compare_layout"), "overlay") 

3234 if compare_enabled: 

3235 with compare_slot: 

3236 compare_participant, compare_trial = _render_compare_selector( 

3237 combos, 

3238 selection_mode, 

3239 selected_participant, 

3240 selected_trial, 

3241 selected_text, 

3242 animate=animate, 

3243 # CMP-6: lets the selector order candidates by similarity to the 

3244 # selected trial (NLD), fixation count, or reading time. 

3245 fixations_filtered=fixations_filtered,

3254 # Stimulus-image background layer (VIZ-4) — only when toggled on. A 

3255 # user-uploaded image WINS over the dataset's built-in one (VIZ-4 fix): the 

3256 # upload is an explicit override, so it must beat the bundled demo's / a 

3257 # MultiplEYE session's image. The upload is stretched to fill the monitor at 

3258 # (0,0); the dataset image carries a precise per-trial origin/size (pass the 

3259 # path — a small cache key; plots.py base64-encodes it). Either way the manual 

3260 # nudge below lets the user fine-tune the fit to the text + fixations. 

3261 upload_uri = viz_settings.get("stimulus_image_upload_uri") 

3262 if viz_settings.get("show_stimulus_image") and upload_uri: 

3263 base_image = upload_uri 

3264 base_size = (float(canvas_width), float(canvas_height)) 

3265 base_origin = (0.0, 0.0) 

3266 elif viz_settings.get("show_stimulus_image") and has_stimulus_image:

3268 base_size = trial_image_size 

3269 base_origin = trial_image_origin 

3270 else: 

3271 base_image = None 

3272 base_size = None 

3273 base_origin = None 

3274 # VIZ-4: manual alignment — nudge the image origin (dx, dy) and scale its size 

3275 # so the user can line the stimulus up with the text boxes / fixations when the 

3276 # data's coordinate frame doesn't match the image exactly. 

3277 if base_image is not None and base_size is not None:

3279 dy = float(viz_settings.get("stimulus_image_offset_y", 0.0)) 

3280 scale = float(viz_settings.get("stimulus_image_scale", 1.0)) or 1.0 

3281 ox, oy = base_origin or (0.0, 0.0) 

3282 figure_settings["background_image"] = base_image 

3283 figure_settings["background_image_size"] = ( 

3284 base_size[0] * scale, 

3285 base_size[1] * scale, 

3286 ) 

3287 figure_settings["background_image_origin"] = (ox + dx, oy + dy) 

3288 else: 

3289 figure_settings["background_image"] = None 

3290 figure_settings["background_image_size"] = None 

3291 figure_settings["background_image_origin"] = None 

3292 # Opacity applies to whichever image is shown (dataset or uploaded); harmless 

3293 # when no image is drawn. 

3294 figure_settings["background_image_opacity"] = viz_settings.get( 

3295 "stimulus_image_opacity", 1.0 

3296 )

3300 figure_settings["scale_text_to_boxes"] = scale_text_to_boxes

3337 and raw_gaze is not None 

3338 and not raw_gaze.empty, 

3339 )

3355 # PRE-3 drift correction (VIZ-23) — hoisted ABOVE the render-mode split, so the 

3356 # two Drift-correction controls apply on ALL THREE paths instead of the static 

3357 # figure alone. Each scanpath is corrected against its OWN words frame, on the 

3358 # already-windowed fixations (so the algorithm sees exactly what is drawn, as 

3359 # the static path always did). What each builder can then do with it: 

3360 # • static — snapped y + colour-by-line + optional original→corrected 

3361 # connectors (it is the only builder with a connector layer); 

3362 # • animation — snapped y + colour-by-line on the single replay. No 

3363 # connectors: the replay reveals one growing trail, and a 

3364 # full-length static "original position" layer standing there 

3365 # from frame zero would misread as part of the scanpath. 

3366 # • comparison — snapped y for both scanpaths; that builder has neither a 

3367 # colour-by-line nor a connector layer, so correction is the 

3368 # whole of it. 

3369 # "Off" (the default) is a genuine no-op — `_drift_corrected` hands back the 

3370 # same frame object, so no path changes and no figure cache entry is busted. 

3371 align_algorithm = viz_settings.get("align_algorithm", "Off")

3378 ) 

3379 # `make_comparison_figure` pulls exactly the two selected trials out of the 

3380 # frame it is handed (its shared colour range included), so a frame holding 

3381 # just those two corrected scanpaths is equivalent to patching the whole 

3382 # filtered corpus — and far cheaper. Untouched when correction is off.

3384 pd.concat([trial_words, compare_meta["words"]]) 

3385 if comparing and compare_meta is not None 

3386 else trial_words

3389 pd.concat([plot_fixations, plot_compare_fix]) if comparing else plot_fixations

3406 # cluster — styles.py lays every such container out as a right-packed

3620 # PERF-3: `st.tabs` executes EVERY tab's body on every run — only the

3627 # `on_change="rerun"`, each tab object exposes `.open`, so a body can

3744def _render_bulk_export(

3747 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

3748 combos_all: pd.DataFrame,

3752 *,

3755 base_font_size: int, 

3756 font_family: str, 

3757 x_field: str, 

3758 y_field: str, 

3759 figure_settings: dict, 

3760) -> None: 

3761 """Render configurable bulk-export UI (artifact picker + run + download).""" 

3762 options = render_export_options( 

3763 st, 

3764 combos, 

3765 key_prefix="bulk_export", 

3766 combos_all=combos_all, 

3767 title_pattern=figure_settings.get("title_pattern", ""),

3769 ) 

3770 # Tick "Export the whole dataset" → export the unfiltered frames. 

3771 if options.export_unfiltered: 

3772 active_combos, active_words, active_fix = combos_all, words_all, fixations_all 

3773 else: 

3774 active_combos, active_words, active_fix = ( 

3775 combos, 

3776 words_filtered, 

3777 fixations_filtered, 

3778 ) 

3779 run_col, info_col = st.columns([1, 3]) 

3780 with run_col: 

3781 run = st.button( 

3782 "Build export", 

3783 type="primary", 

3784 disabled=( 

3785 active_combos.empty 

3786 or not ( 

3787 options.figure_formats() 

3788 or options.include_plot_config 

3789 or options.any_table() 

3790 ) 

3791 ), 

3792 ) 

3793 sig = ( 

3794 frame_fingerprint(active_combos), 

3795 frame_fingerprint(active_words), 

3796 frame_fingerprint(active_fix), 

3797 frame_fingerprint(raw_gaze), 

3798 int(canvas_width), 

3799 int(canvas_height), 

3800 int(base_font_size), 

3801 str(font_family), 

3802 str(x_field), 

3803 str(y_field), 

3804 json.dumps(figure_settings, sort_keys=True, default=str), 

3805 repr(options), 

3806 EXPORTER_VERSION, 

3807 ) 

3808 cache = st.session_state.get("_bulk_export_cache") 

3809 if cache and cache.get("sig") != sig: 

3810 st.session_state.pop("_bulk_export_cache", None) 

3811 cache = None 

3812 

3813 if run: 

3814 status_box = info_col.status("Preparing bulk export…", expanded=True) 

3815 progress_slot = info_col.empty() 

3816 progress_bar = None 

3817 

3818 def on_status(status: ExportStatus) -> None: 

3819 nonlocal progress_bar 

3820 elapsed = f" · {status.elapsed_s:.1f}s" if status.elapsed_s else "" 

3821 state = ( 

3822 "complete" 

3823 if status.stage == ExportStage.READY 

3824 else "error" 

3825 if status.stage == ExportStage.ERROR 

3826 else "running" 

3827 ) 

3828 status_box.update(label=f"{status.message}{elapsed}", state=state) 

3829 if status.fraction is not None: 

3830 text = f"{status.completed}/{status.total} trials · {status.message}" 

3831 if progress_bar is None: 

3832 progress_bar = progress_slot.progress(status.fraction, text=text) 

3833 else: 

3834 progress_bar.progress(status.fraction, text=text) 

3835 

3836 try: 

3837 zip_bytes, progress = bulk_export( 

3838 active_combos, 

3839 active_words, 

3840 active_fix, 

3841 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

3842 canvas_height=canvas_height, 

3843 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

3844 font_family=font_family, 

3845 x_field=x_field, 

3846 y_field=y_field, 

3847 settings=figure_settings, 

3848 options=options, 

3849 raw_gaze=raw_gaze, 

3850 status_callback=on_status, 

3851 ) 

3852 except Exception as exc: 

3853 progress_slot.empty() 

3854 status_box.update(label=f"Export failed: {exc}", state="error") 

3855 st.session_state.pop("_bulk_export_cache", None) 

3856 st.warning(f"Could not build export: {exc}") 

3857 cache = None 

3858 else: 

3859 progress_slot.empty() 

3860 cache = {"sig": sig, "data": zip_bytes, "progress": progress} 

3861 st.session_state["_bulk_export_cache"] = cache 

3862 

3863 if cache and cache.get("sig") == sig: 

3864 zip_bytes = cache["data"] 

3865 progress = cache["progress"] 

3866 info_col.success(f"Ready · {len(zip_bytes) / 1_048_576:.1f} MB") 

3867 if progress.errors: 

3868 with st.expander("Export warnings"): 

3869 for err in progress.errors: 

3870 st.write(err) 

3871 st.download_button( 

3872 "Download zip", 

3873 data=zip_bytes, 

3874 file_name=f"scanpath_export_{pd.Timestamp.now('UTC'):%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}.zip", 

3875 mime="application/zip", 

3876 type="primary", 

3877 ) 

3878

3880def _render_comparison_figure( 

3881 combos: pd.DataFrame, 

3882 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

3883 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

3884 selected_participant: str, 

3885 selected_trial: str, 

3886 selected_text: Optional[str], 

3887 compare_participant: str, 

3888 compare_trial: str, 

3889 settings: FigureSettings, 

3890 viz_settings: dict, 

3891 layout: str = "overlay", 

3892 fix_index_range=None, 

3893): 

3894 """Render comparison figure for two trials. 

3895 

3896 ``fix_index_range`` (VIZ-7) windows both scanpaths to a ``(start, end)`` 

3897 ``order_in_trial`` range; ``None`` shows the full readings. Shared visual 

3898 choices, canvas geometry, and the stimulus image arrive in ``settings``. 

3899 

3900 ``fixations_filtered`` may already carry PRE-3 drift-corrected ``y`` values — 

3901 correction happens once, upstream of the render-mode split.""" 

3902 text_field = "unique_text_id" if "unique_text_id" in combos.columns else "text_id" 

3903 # Window both compared trials to the chosen fixation-index range. Slicing the 

3904 # whole frame is fine — make_comparison_figure only extracts the two trials. 

3905 fixations_filtered = _slice_fix_range(fixations_filtered, fix_index_range) 

3906 

3907 def _lookup_text_id(participant_id: str, trial_id: str) -> Optional[str]: 

3908 match = combos[ 

3909 (combos["participant_id"] == participant_id) 

3910 & (combos["trial_id"] == trial_id) 

3911 ] 

3912 if match.empty or text_field not in match.columns: 

3913 return None 

3914 return str(match.iloc[0][text_field]) 

3915 

3916 label_pool: set[str] = set() 

3917 primary_text_id = selected_text or _lookup_text_id( 

3918 selected_participant, selected_trial 

3919 ) 

3920 compare_text_id = _lookup_text_id(compare_participant, compare_trial) 

3921 primary_label = friendly_trial_label( 

3922 selected_participant, selected_trial, primary_text_id, label_pool 

3923 ) 

3924 compare_label = friendly_trial_label( 

3925 compare_participant, compare_trial, compare_text_id, label_pool 

3926 ) 

3927 # UX-31: an explicit cmp{idx}_label_pattern overrides the auto label above. 

3928 if st.session_state.get("cmp0_label_pattern"): 

3929 primary_label = _resolve_compare_label( 

3930 0, 

3931 selected_participant, 

3932 selected_trial, 

3933 extract_trial(words_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial), 

3934 extract_trial(fixations_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial), 

3935 ) 

3936 if st.session_state.get("cmp1_label_pattern"): 

3937 compare_label = _resolve_compare_label( 

3938 1, 

3939 compare_participant, 

3940 compare_trial, 

3941 extract_trial(words_filtered, compare_participant, compare_trial), 

3942 extract_trial(fixations_filtered, compare_participant, compare_trial), 

3943 ) 

3944 

3945 comparison_settings = settings.with_overrides( 

3946 trial_labels=(primary_label, compare_label), 

3947 layout=layout, 

3948 style_a=viz_settings.get("compare_style_a"), 

3949 style_b=viz_settings.get("compare_style_b"), 

3950 show_legend=viz_settings.get("show_compare_legend", False), 

3951 # Comparison retains its count-vs-duration spelling; the static builder 

3952 # translates "counts" to None internally. 

3953 heatmap_metric=viz_settings.get("heatmap_metric", "duration_ms"), 

3954 highlight_column=_marked_text_column(viz_settings), 

3955 ) 

3956 fig_compare = make_comparison_figure( 

3957 words_filtered, 

3958 fixations_filtered, 

3959 (selected_participant, selected_trial), 

3960 (compare_participant, compare_trial), 

3961 settings=comparison_settings, 

3962 ) 

3963 add_illustration_label(fig_compare, viz_settings.get("illustration_reasons")) 

3964 _apply_preprocessing_caption(fig_compare, selected_participant, selected_trial) 

3965 _primary_combo = combos[ 

3966 (combos["participant_id"] == selected_participant) 

3967 & (combos["trial_id"] == selected_trial) 

3968 ] 

3969 _apply_title_caption( 

3970 fig_compare, 

3971 viz_settings, 

3972 extract_trial(words_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial), 

3973 extract_trial(fixations_filtered, selected_participant, selected_trial), 

3974 selected_participant, 

3975 selected_trial, 

3976 combo_row=( 

3977 _primary_combo.iloc[0].to_dict() if not _primary_combo.empty else None 

3978 ), 

3979 ) 

3980 _render_true_scale_chart(fig_compare, key="compare") 

3981 return fig_compare 

3982

3984# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

3985# Corpus Analysis Tab (Per text · Per reader · Groups subtabs)

3987 

3988# --- Cached analysis wrappers ------------------------------------------------ 

3989# Each wraps a pure ``aggregation`` helper with ``@st.cache_data`` keyed on a 

3990# cheap frame *fingerprint* (``fkey``) + hashable scalars (the measure key, 

3991# aggregation/spread, flags), mirroring the existing cached-aggregation pattern. 

3992# Frames pass 

3993# un-hashed (underscore args). Group views feed a pre-filtered frame, so its 

3994# fingerprint keys a separate cache entry automatically. 

3995

4000 _words, text_col, text_id, MEASURES[mkey], agg=agg, normalize=normalize 

4001 )

4028 _words,

4082def _measure_picker( 

4083 words, fixations, *, key, host=None, per_word_only=False, label="Measure" 

4084) -> Optional["Measure"]: 

4085 """The shared measure picker (AN-23) — TFD default, only present columns.""" 

4086 host = host or st 

4087 ms = available_measures(words, fixations, per_word_only=per_word_only) 

4088 if not ms: 

4089 host.info("No aggregatable measures found in this dataset.") 

4090 return None

4092 options = list(labels) 

4093 default = "Total fixation duration — TFD" 

4094 index = options.index(default) if default in options else 0 

4095 chosen = host.selectbox( 

4096 label, 

4097 options=options, 

4098 index=index, 

4099 key=key, 

4100 help="The eye-movement measure every view in this section reads.", 

4101 ) 

4102 return MEASURES[labels[chosen]]

4109 "Z-score within reader",

4111 key=key,

4113 help="Compare slow vs fast readers on shape, not absolute level.", 

4114 ) 

4115 )

4118def _min_readers_input(host, *, key, label="Min readers per word", default=1): 

4119 """Min-observations guard (AN-26)."""

4121 host.number_input( 

4122 label, 

4123 min_value=1, 

4124 max_value=999, 

4125 value=default, 

4126 step=1,

4129 )

4133def _download_tidy(host, df, *, name, key, label="⬇ Download this table (CSV)"): 

4134 """Per-view tidy-table download (AN-27).""" 

4135 if df is None or getattr(df, "empty", True): 

4136 return

4138 label, 

4139 data=df.to_csv(index=False).encode("utf-8"),

4143 ) 

4144 

4145 

4146#: Cell text of the "open this trial" button. `st.column_config.ButtonColumn` 

4147#: takes the button's label from the cell *value*, so this is data, not config. 

4148_OPEN_TRIAL_LABEL = ":material/open_in_new: Open" 

4149 

4150 

4151def _render_trials_with_open_button( 

4152 trials: pd.DataFrame, participant: Optional[str], *, key: str 

4153) -> None: 

4154 """A per-trial summary table whose rows open the trial (ENG-36). 

4155 

4156 Corpus Analysis lists a reader's trials with their numbers; acting on one 

4157 meant reading its id off the table, switching to the Scanpath view and 

4158 hunting it down in the picker. Streamlit 1.61's `ButtonColumn` puts the jump 

4159 in the row it belongs to. 

4160 

4161 The click arrives as a *callback*, before the script rebuilds ``combos``, so 

4162 it can't seed the picker itself — it parks the request via 

4163 ``url_state.request_trial`` and ``app.main`` applies it once the trial pool 

4164 exists, the same hop a ``?trial_id=`` deep link takes. 

4165 """ 

4166 if trials is None or trials.empty or "trial_id" not in trials.columns: 

4167 st.dataframe(trials, width="stretch", hide_index=True) 

4168 return 

4169 click_key = f"{key}_open_trial_click" 

4170 # `click["row"]` is a position in the frame we hand to `st.dataframe`, not in 

4171 # whatever order the user has clicked the table's headers into — the same 

4172 # source-position semantics as dataframe *selections* (Streamlit's own 

4173 # ButtonColumn example indexes `df.iloc[click["row"]]`). So a parallel list 

4174 # built from that frame stays correct under client-side sorting. 

4175 ids = trials["trial_id"].astype(str).tolist() 

4176 

4177 def _open() -> None: 

4178 # Imported at call time, like the PLOT_CONFIG_SCHEMA read above: 

4179 # `url_state` imports nothing from here, and this keeps it that way. 

4180 from scanpath_studio.url_state import request_trial 

4181 

4182 click = st.session_state.get(click_key) 

4183 row = click["row"] if click else None 

4184 if row is not None and 0 <= row < len(ids): 

4185 request_trial(participant, ids[row]) 

4186 

4187 shown = trials.copy() 

4188 shown.insert(0, "Open", _OPEN_TRIAL_LABEL) 

4189 st.dataframe( 

4190 shown, 

4191 width="stretch", 

4192 hide_index=True, 

4193 column_config={ 

4194 "Open": st.column_config.ButtonColumn( 

4195 "", 

4196 type="tertiary", 

4197 width="small", 

4198 help="Show this trial's scanpath in the Scanpath view.", 

4199 on_click=_open, 

4200 key=click_key, 

4201 ) 

4202 }, 

4203 ) 

4204 

4205 

4206def _apply_min_readers(host, df, min_readers, *, key): 

4207 """Drop under-supported word rows and caption the count (AN-26).""" 

4208 if df is None or df.empty or "enough" not in df.columns or min_readers <= 1: 

4209 return df 

4210 dropped = int((~df["enough"]).sum()) 

4211 out = df[df["enough"]] 

4212 if dropped: 

4213 host.caption(f"⚠️ {dropped} word(s) backed by < {min_readers} readers hidden.") 

4214 return out 

4215 

4216 

4217# --- Group definition (AN-14 … AN-22) ---------------------------------------- 

4218# Two modes (the user asked for both): *split a field* — pick one categorical 

4219# column and assign its values to A vs B — and *independent filter sets* — a full 

4220# participant/text/condition picker per group. Both reduce to a group ``spec`` 

4221# (``{column: [allowed values]}``) consumed by ``aggregation.group_mask``. 

4222 

4223_GROUP_SPLIT_CANDIDATES = ( 

4224 "difficulty_level", 

4225 "question_preview", 

4226 "repeated_reading_trial", 

4227 "is_correct", 

4228 "genre", 

4229 "session", 

4230 "pp_gender", 

4231 "participant_id", 

4232) 

4233_FILTER_SET_FIELDS = ( 

4234 "difficulty_level", 

4235 "question_preview", 

4236 "repeated_reading_trial", 

4237 "is_correct", 

4238 "genre", 

4239 "session", 

4240) 

4241 

4242 

4243def _both_frame_values(words, fixations, col): 

4244 frames = [f for f in (fixations, words) if col in getattr(f, "columns", [])] 

4245 vals = set() 

4246 for f in frames: 

4247 vals |= set(f[col].astype(str).dropna().unique()) 

4248 return sorted(vals) 

4249 

4250 

4251def _group_split_columns(words, fixations): 

4252 """Categorical columns present in BOTH frames with 2…60 values.""" 

4253 out = [] 

4254 text_col = _text_column(words) or _text_column(fixations) 

4255 candidates = list(_GROUP_SPLIT_CANDIDATES) + ([text_col] if text_col else []) 

4256 for col in dict.fromkeys(candidates): 

4257 if col in words.columns and col in fixations.columns: 

4258 n = words[col].astype(str).nunique() 

4259 if 2 <= n <= 60: 

4260 out.append(col) 

4261 return out 

4262 

4263 

4264def _join_label(values): 

4265 vals = [str(v) for v in (values or [])] 

4266 if not vals: 

4267 return "" 

4268 return vals[0] if len(vals) == 1 else f"{vals[0]} +{len(vals) - 1}" 

4269 

4270 

4271def _render_filter_set(words, fixations, *, key, default_label): 

4272 """One independent group's filter-set picker → ``(spec, label)``.""" 

4273 spec = {} 

4274 label = st.text_input("Label", value=default_label, key=f"{key}_label") 

4275 text_col = _text_column(fixations) or _text_column(words) 

4276 for col, pretty in ( 

4277 ("participant_id", "Participants"), 

4278 (text_col, "Texts"), 

4279 *[(c, _pretty_col(c)) for c in _FILTER_SET_FIELDS], 

4280 ): 

4281 if not col: 

4282 continue 

4283 opts = _both_frame_values(words, fixations, col) 

4284 if len(opts) < 2 or len(opts) > 400: 

4285 continue 

4286 sel = st.multiselect(pretty, opts, key=f"{key}_{col}", placeholder="All") 

4287 if sel: 

4288 spec[col] = sel 

4289 return spec, (label or default_label) 

4290 

4291 

4292def _render_group_definition(words, fixations, *, key, two_groups, host=None): 

4293 """Group-definition UI → one ``spec``/``(spec, label)`` or two ``(a, b, la, lb)``.""" 

4294 host = host or st 

4295 mode = host.radio( 

4296 "Define group(s) by", 

4297 ["Split a field", "Independent filter sets"], 

4298 key=f"{key}_mode", 

4299 horizontal=True, 

4300 help="Split one categorical column into groups, or build each group from " 

4301 "its own participant/text/condition filter.", 

4302 ) 

4303 if mode == "Split a field": 

4304 cols = _group_split_columns(words, fixations) 

4305 if not cols: 

4306 host.info( 

4307 "No categorical field with ≥2 values shared by both tables — use " 

4308 "*Independent filter sets* instead." 

4309 ) 

4310 return (None, None, "Group A", "Group B") if two_groups else (None, "Group") 

4311 col = host.selectbox("Field", cols, key=f"{key}_field", format_func=_pretty_col) 

4312 vals = _both_frame_values(words, fixations, col) 

4313 if two_groups: 

4314 c = host.columns(2) 

4315 a = c[0].multiselect( 

4316 f"Group A — {_pretty_col(col)}", vals, default=vals[:1], key=f"{key}_a" 

4317 ) 

4318 rest = [v for v in vals if v not in a] 

4319 b = c[1].multiselect( 

4320 f"Group B — {_pretty_col(col)}", vals, default=rest[:1], key=f"{key}_b" 

4321 ) 

4322 return ( 

4323 ({col: a} if a else {}), 

4324 ({col: b} if b else {}), 

4325 _join_label(a) or "Group A", 

4326 _join_label(b) or "Group B", 

4327 ) 

4328 sel = host.multiselect( 

4329 f"{_pretty_col(col)} =", vals, default=vals[:1], key=f"{key}_g" 

4330 ) 

4331 return ({col: sel} if sel else {}), (_join_label(sel) or "All") 

4332 # Independent filter sets. 

4333 if two_groups: 

4334 c = host.columns(2) 

4335 with c[0]: 

4336 st.markdown("**Group A**") 

4337 sa, la = _render_filter_set( 

4338 words, fixations, key=f"{key}_setA", default_label="Group A" 

4339 ) 

4340 with c[1]: 

4341 st.markdown("**Group B**") 

4342 sb, lb = _render_filter_set( 

4343 words, fixations, key=f"{key}_setB", default_label="Group B" 

4344 ) 

4345 return sa, sb, la, lb 

4346 spec, label = _render_filter_set( 

4347 words, fixations, key=f"{key}_set0", default_label="Group" 

4348 ) 

4349 return spec, label 

4350 

4351 

4352def _warn_word_only_group_fields(host, fixations, *specs) -> None: 

4353 """Warn when a group is defined on a field absent from the fixation table. 

4354 

4355 ``group_mask`` filters per frame, so a word-only spec column leaves the 

4356 fixation frame unfiltered — the *fixation-level* views (distributions for a 

4357 per-fixation measure, paired bars, effect size) would then silently compare 

4358 all-vs-all. Surfacing it beats a misleading comparison. 

4359 """ 

4360 missing = sorted( 

4361 { 

4362 col 

4363 for spec in specs 

4364 for col, vals in (spec or {}).items() 

4365 if vals and col not in getattr(fixations, "columns", []) 

4366 } 

4367 ) 

4368 if missing: 

4369 host.warning( 

4370 "Group field(s) " 

4371 + ", ".join(_pretty_col(c) for c in missing) 

4372 + " aren't in the fixation table, so the fixation-level views " 

4373 "(distributions for a per-fixation measure, paired bars, effect " 

4374 "size) can't split on them. Use a field present in both tables for " 

4375 "those views." 

4376 ) 

4377 

4378 

4379def _text_column(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> Optional[str]: 

4380 """Canonical text/passage id column, if any.""" 

4381 for col in ("unique_text_id", "text_id", "unique_paragraph_id", "paragraph_id"): 

4382 if col in frame.columns: 

4383 return col 

4384 return None

4387def render_corpus_analysis_tab( 

4388 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

4389 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

4390 *, 

4391 canvas_width: int, 

4392 canvas_height: int, 

4393 base_font_size: int, 

4394 font_family: str, 

4395 viz_settings: dict, 

4396 line_spacing: float = DEFAULT_LINE_SPACING, 

4397 scale_text_to_boxes: bool = True, 

4398 canvas_renderer: Optional[Callable[[Any], None]] = None, 

4399) -> None: 

4400 """Corpus Analysis tab — question-oriented analysis sections. 

4401 

4402 Replaces the single *Aggregated Views* subtab with one subtab per question — 

4403 **Per text** (one text, many readers), **Per reader** (one reader, many 

4404 trials), and **Groups** (profile one cohort, or flip a toggle to compare two). 

4405 Every section obeys the active trial filters and reads the shared measure 

4406 picker / aggregation / spread / normalization controls. (**Generations** moved 

4407 to the Scanpath view's **Comparisons** subtab — ENG-8.) 

4408 """ 

4409 viz_settings = corpus_style_controls( 

4410 fixations_filtered, 

4411 base_font_size, 

4412 words=words_filtered, 

4413 host=st, 

4414 # VIZ-31: this view renders true-to-scale stimulus figures from the 

4415 # canvas / typography settings, so it hosts that panel too — the rail 

4416 # (its other home) doesn't exist here. 

4417 canvas_renderer=canvas_renderer, 

4418 ) 

4419 common = dict( 

4420 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

4421 canvas_height=canvas_height, 

4422 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

4423 font_family=font_family, 

4424 line_spacing=line_spacing, 

4425 scale_text_to_boxes=scale_text_to_boxes, 

4426 ) 

4427 text_tab, sentence_tab, reader_tab, groups_tab = st.tabs( 

4428 ["Per text", "Per sentence", "Per reader", "Groups"] 

4429 ) 

4430 with text_tab: 

4431 render_per_text_tab( 

4432 words_filtered, fixations_filtered, viz_settings=viz_settings, **common 

4433 ) 

4434 with reader_tab: 

4435 render_per_reader_tab( 

4436 words_filtered, 

4437 fixations_filtered, 

4438 viz_settings=viz_settings, 

4439 **common, 

4440 ) 

4441 with sentence_tab: 

4442 from scanpath_studio.preprocessing import sentence_measures 

4443 

4444 sentence_table = sentence_measures( 

4445 compute_word_metrics(words_filtered, fixations_filtered), 

4446 fixations_filtered, 

4447 ) 

4448 st.caption( 

4449 "Sentence is a first-class aggregation unit: combine one measure " 

4450 "across readers for each text/sentence pair." 

4451 ) 

4452 numeric = [ 

4453 column 

4454 for column in sentence_table.select_dtypes(include="number").columns 

4455 if column not in {"sentence_id"} 

4456 ] 

4457 if sentence_table.empty or not numeric: 

4458 st.info("No sentence-level measures are available for this selection.") 

4459 else: 

4460 controls = st.columns(2) 

4461 metric = controls[0].selectbox( 

4462 "Sentence measure", numeric, key="sentence_measure" 

4463 ) 

4464 aggregate = controls[1].selectbox( 

4465 "Aggregate", ["Mean", "Median"], key="sentence_aggregate" 

4466 ) 

4467 identity = [ 

4468 column 

4469 for column in ("text_id", "sentence_id") 

4470 if column in sentence_table 

4471 ] 

4472 reducer = "mean" if aggregate == "Mean" else "median" 

4473 summary = ( 

4474 sentence_table.groupby(identity, dropna=False)[metric] 

4475 .agg(reducer) 

4476 .reset_index(name=f"{reducer}_{metric}") 

4477 ) 

4478 st.dataframe(summary, hide_index=True, width="stretch") 

4479 with groups_tab: 

4480 render_groups_tab( 

4481 words_filtered, 

4482 fixations_filtered, 

4483 viz_settings=viz_settings, 

4484 **common, 

4485 ) 

4486 

4487

4493def _chart(fig) -> None: 

4494 """Render a non-spatial Plotly figure stretched to the column width.""" 

4495 st.plotly_chart(fig, width="stretch")

4498def _corpus_series_colors(viz_settings: dict) -> tuple[str, str]: 

4499 """Palette-derived primary/secondary colours shared by corpus builders.""" 

4500 return ( 

4501 viz_settings.get("fixation_color", DEFAULT_FIXATION_COLOR), 

4502 viz_settings.get("saccade_color", SACCADE_COLOR), 

4503 )

4506def _text_picker(words: pd.DataFrame, *, key: str, host=None, label: str = "Text"): 

4507 """Pick one text/passage; returns ``(text_col, text_id)`` (``None`` if none).""" 

4508 host = host or st 

4509 text_col = _text_column(words) 

4510 if text_col is None or "word_id" not in words.columns: 

4511 return None, None 

4512 counts = text_read_counts(words, text_col) 

4513 if not counts.empty: 

4514 labels = { 

4515 f"{row.text} ({row.n_participants} readers)": row.text 

4516 for row in counts.itertuples() 

4517 } 

4518 chosen = host.selectbox(label, list(labels), key=key) 

4519 return text_col, labels[chosen] 

4520 vals = sorted(words[text_col].astype(str).unique()) 

4521 if not vals: 

4522 return text_col, None 

4523 return text_col, host.selectbox(label, vals, key=key) 

4524 

4525 

4526def _participant_picker(words, fixations, *, key, host=None, label="Reader"): 

4527 host = host or st 

4528 for frame in (fixations, words): 

4529 if frame is not None and not frame.empty and "participant_id" in frame.columns: 

4530 opts = sorted(frame["participant_id"].astype(str).unique()) 

4531 if opts: 

4532 return host.selectbox(label, opts, key=key) 

4533 return None 

4534 

4535 

4536def _percentile(series: pd.Series, value) -> Optional[float]: 

4537 s = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").dropna() 

4538 if s.empty or value is None or pd.isna(value): 

4539 return None 

4540 return float((s < value).mean() * 100.0)

4795def render_per_reader_tab( 

4796 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

4797 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

4798 *, 

4799 viz_settings: dict, 

4800 canvas_width: int, 

4801 canvas_height: int, 

4802 base_font_size: int, 

4803 font_family: str, 

4804 line_spacing: float = DEFAULT_LINE_SPACING, 

4805 scale_text_to_boxes: bool = True, 

4806) -> None: 

4807 """*What does this reader look like?* — one reader, many trials (AN-7…13).""" 

4808 st.caption( 

4809 "One **reader**, all their trials, against the cohort behind. Distributions, " 

4810 "a reading-speed summary, within-trial dynamics, the oculomotor scatter, " 

4811 "progressive/regressive saccades, the landing-position curve, and this " 

4812 "reader's per-trial trend." 

4813 ) 

4814 if fixations_filtered.empty and words_filtered.empty: 

4815 st.info("No data after filtering.") 

4816 return 

4817 top = st.columns([2, 3]) 

4818 pid = _participant_picker( 

4819 words_filtered, fixations_filtered, key="prdr_pid", host=top[0] 

4820 ) 

4821 if pid is None: 

4822 st.info("No participant column found.") 

4823 return 

4824 fix_e = _c_enrich_fix( 

4825 fixations_filtered, 

4826 words_filtered, 

4827 frame_fingerprint(fixations_filtered), 

4828 frame_fingerprint(words_filtered), 

4829 ) 

4830 view = top[1].selectbox( 

4831 "View", 

4832 [ 

4833 "Distribution vs cohort", 

4834 "Reading summary", 

4835 "Fixation duration over time", 

4836 "Saccade vs fixation duration", 

4837 "Progressive vs regressive", 

4838 "Landing-position curve", 

4839 "Per-trial trend", 

4840 ], 

4841 key="prdr_view", 

4842 ) 

4843 fw = dict( 

4844 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

4845 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

4846 font_family=font_family, 

4847 ) 

4848 

4849 if view == "Distribution vs cohort": # AN-7 

4850 c = st.columns([3, 1, 1]) 

4851 measure = _measure_picker( 

4852 words_filtered, fixations_filtered, key="prdr_measure", host=c[0] 

4853 ) 

4854 if measure is None: 

4855 return 

4856 kind = c[1].selectbox("Plot", ["violin", "box"], key="prdr7_kind") 

4857 normalize = _normalize_toggle(c[2], key="prdr7_norm", disabled=measure.is_rate) 

4858 frame = fix_e if measure.frame == "fixations" else words_filtered 

4859 groups = reader_vs_cohort_values(frame, pid, measure, normalize=normalize) 

4860 _chart( 

4861 make_distribution_figure( 

4862 groups, 

4863 metric_label=measure.axis_label, 

4864 kind=kind, 

4865 colors=_corpus_series_colors(viz_settings), 

4866 **fw, 

4867 ) 

4868 ) 

4869 elif view == "Reading summary": # AN-8 

4870 summary = reader_summary(words_filtered, fix_e, pid) 

4871 cohort = _c_cohort_summary( 

4872 words_filtered, 

4873 fix_e, 

4874 frame_fingerprint(words_filtered), 

4875 frame_fingerprint(fix_e), 

4876 ) 

4877 # ENG-36: `st.metric(icon=…)` (1.61). Six numbers in one row read as an 

4878 # undifferentiated wall; the glyph is what lets you find "the speed one" 

4879 # without reading every label. Chosen to say what the number *is*, not to 

4880 # decorate — speed, duration, count, direction of travel. 

4881 specs = [ 

4882 ("wpm", "Reading speed", "{:.0f} wpm", ":material/speed:"), 

4883 ("mean_fixation_ms", "Mean fixation", "{:.0f} ms", ":material/timer:"), 

4884 ("n_fixations", "Fixations", "{:.0f}", ":material/blur_on:"), 

4885 ( 

4886 "regression_rate", 

4887 "Regression rate", 

4888 "{:.0%}", 

4889 ":material/keyboard_backspace:", 

4890 ), 

4891 ("skip_rate", "Skip rate", "{:.0%}", ":material/fast_forward:"), 

4892 ("mean_saccade_px", "Mean saccade", "{:.1f} px", ":material/arrow_range:"), 

4893 ] 

4894 present = [s for s in specs if s[0] in summary] 

4895 cols = st.columns(len(present)) if present else [] 

4896 for col, (skey, label, fmt, icon) in zip(cols, present): 

4897 value = summary.get(skey) 

4898 pct = ( 

4899 _percentile(cohort[skey], value) 

4900 if skey in getattr(cohort, "columns", []) 

4901 else None 

4902 ) 

4903 col.metric( 

4904 label, 

4905 fmt.format(value) if value is not None else "—", 

4906 delta=(f"{pct:.0f}th pct" if pct is not None else None), 

4907 delta_color="off", 

4908 icon=icon, 

4909 ) 

4910 st.caption( 

4911 f"Reader **{pid}** vs the {max(len(cohort) - 1, 0)} other readers " 

4912 "in scope (percentiles)." 

4913 ) 

4914 trials = _c_trial_summary( 

4915 words_filtered, 

4916 fix_e, 

4917 frame_fingerprint(words_filtered), 

4918 frame_fingerprint(fix_e), 

4919 ) 

4920 trials = trials[trials["participant_id"].astype(str) == str(pid)] 

4921 with st.expander("Summary tables", expanded=False): 

4922 reader_table, trial_table = st.tabs(["Reader", "Trials"]) 

4923 with reader_table: 

4924 selected_reader = cohort[ 

4925 cohort["participant_id"].astype(str) == str(pid) 

4926 ] 

4927 st.dataframe(selected_reader, width="stretch", hide_index=True) 

4928 _download_tidy( 

4929 st, 

4930 selected_reader, 

4931 name=f"reader_summary_{pid}.csv", 

4932 key="dl_prdr8_reader", 

4933 ) 

4934 with trial_table: 

4935 _render_trials_with_open_button(trials, pid, key="prdr8") 

4936 _download_tidy( 

4937 st, 

4938 trials, 

4939 name=f"trial_summaries_{pid}.csv", 

4940 key="dl_prdr8_trials", 

4941 ) 

4942 elif view == "Fixation duration over time": # AN-9 

4943 c = st.columns([3, 2]) 

4944 measure = _measure_picker(words_filtered, fix_e, key="prdr_measure", host=c[0]) 

4945 if measure is None or measure.frame != "fixations": 

4946 c[0].info("Pick a per-fixation measure (duration / saccade amplitude).") 

4947 return 

4948 by = c[1].selectbox( 

4949 "X axis", 

4950 ["order_in_trial", "timestamp_ms"], 

4951 key="prdr9_x", 

4952 format_func=lambda s: s.replace("_", " "), 

4953 ) 

4954 df = metric_over_time(fix_e, measure, participant_id=pid, by=by) 

4955 _chart( 

4956 make_trend_figure( 

4957 df, 

4958 x_col="x", 

4959 y_label=measure.axis_label, 

4960 title=f"{measure.label} over {by.replace('_', ' ')} — {pid}", 

4961 **fw, 

4962 ) 

4963 ) 

4964 _download_tidy( 

4965 st, df, name=f"over_time_{measure.key}_{pid}.csv", key="dl_prdr9" 

4966 ) 

4967 elif view == "Saccade vs fixation duration": # AN-10 

4968 df = saccade_vs_duration(fix_e, participant_id=pid) 

4969 _chart( 

4970 make_density_scatter_figure( 

4971 df, 

4972 x_col="duration_ms", 

4973 y_col="saccade_amplitude", 

4974 x_label="Fixation duration (ms)", 

4975 y_label="Saccade amplitude (px)", 

4976 **fw, 

4977 ) 

4978 ) 

4979 elif view == "Progressive vs regressive": # AN-11 

4980 df = progressive_regressive_counts(fix_e, participant_id=pid) 

4981 if df.empty: 

4982 st.info("Needs fixation→word assignment to classify regressions.") 

4983 return 

4984 _chart(make_progression_figure(df, **fw)) 

4985 _download_tidy(st, df, name=f"progression_{pid}.csv", key="dl_prdr11") 

4986 elif view == "Landing-position curve": # AN-12 

4987 vals = landing_positions(words_filtered, fix_e, participant_id=pid) 

4988 if vals.size == 0: 

4989 st.info( 

4990 "Needs first-fixation landing positions (first_fix_x or fixation " 

4991 "x + word boxes)." 

4992 ) 

4993 return 

4994 _chart(make_landing_curve_figure(vals, **fw)) 

4995 elif view == "Per-trial trend": # AN-13 

4996 c = st.columns([3, 1]) 

4997 measure = _measure_picker(words_filtered, fix_e, key="prdr_measure", host=c[0]) 

4998 if measure is None: 

4999 return 

5000 agg = c[1].selectbox( 

5001 "Aggregate", 

5002 _AGG_OPTIONS, 

5003 key="prdr13_agg", 

5004 help="How the measure is combined within each trial (across its words / fixations).", 

5005 ) 

5006 frame = fix_e if measure.frame == "fixations" else words_filtered 

5007 sub = frame[frame["participant_id"].astype(str) == str(pid)].copy() 

5008 if not has_explicit_trial_index(sub): 

5009 st.caption("ℹ️ Trial order derived from fixation timestamps.") 

5010 sub["trial_index"] = derive_trial_index(sub) 

5011 df = metric_by_trial_index(sub, measure.column, agg=agg) 

5012 _chart( 

5013 make_trend_figure( 

5014 df, 

5015 x_col="trial_index", 

5016 y_label=measure.axis_label, 

5017 title=f"{measure.label} by trial index — {pid}", 

5018 **fw, 

5019 ) 

5020 ) 

5021 _download_tidy(st, df, name=f"trend_{measure.key}_{pid}.csv", key="dl_prdr13")

5024def render_groups_tab( 

5025 words_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

5026 fixations_filtered: pd.DataFrame, 

5027 *, 

5028 viz_settings: dict, 

5029 canvas_width: int, 

5030 canvas_height: int, 

5031 base_font_size: int, 

5032 font_family: str, 

5033 line_spacing: float = DEFAULT_LINE_SPACING, 

5034 scale_text_to_boxes: bool = True, 

5035) -> None: 

5036 """*Groups* — profile one cohort, or compare two. 

5037 

5038 One group answers "what does this group look like?"; flip **Compare a second 

5039 group** to define Group B and get the two-cohort comparison views. A single 

5040 group is just the one-group case of a comparison, so both live in one tab. 

5041 """ 

5042 common = dict( 

5043 canvas_width=canvas_width, 

5044 canvas_height=canvas_height, 

5045 base_font_size=base_font_size, 

5046 font_family=font_family, 

5047 line_spacing=line_spacing, 

5048 scale_text_to_boxes=scale_text_to_boxes, 

5049 ) 

5050 compare = st.toggle( 

5051 "Compare a second group", 

5052 value=False, 

5053 key="groups_compare", 

5054 help="Off: profile a single group. On: define a second group and compare " 

5055 "A vs B — difference profile, paired bars, effect size, and more.", 

5056 ) 

5057 if compare: 

5058 render_group_comparison_tab( 

5059 words_filtered, 

5060 fixations_filtered, 

5061 viz_settings=viz_settings, 

5062 **common, 

5063 ) 

5064 else: 

5065 render_per_group_tab( 

5066 words_filtered, 

5067 fixations_filtered, 

5068 viz_settings=viz_settings, 

5069 **common, 

5070 ) 

5071
